note: host-runtime F007 / design.md C4. The machine-readable manifest of what a release drop contains, one entry per file. This file is the single authority: docs/release.md restates it as a table and test/PackagingSpec.hs asserts the two agree in both directions, so dropping a file from a platform turns 'cabal test' red. The 'role' vocabulary is closed - runtime, runtime-closure, import-lib-mingw, import-lib-msvc, header, version - and 'verified' is an honesty field: false means the build settings are written but no machine has produced or checked that drop.

files.name: *.so*
files.note: Every shared object the runtime resolves, copied next to it; the file count varies with dependency resolution, so the manifest records that the role exists and packaging/pack.sh --verify guarantees the set is self-contained.
